description: Read-only: every setting of one shot as JSON (place, cast, actions, emotions, texts, camera and camera keys, lighting, transition, keyframes), with its scene and shot index. Name the shot with shot_id, or scene and shot indexes; left out, the shot on screen. Use it to see exact fields and ids before edit_project or set_keyframes. For a short view of all shots use get_project; to see the shot as a picture use look_at_shot.

scene.description: Scene index from 0 (with shot). Used when shot_id isn't given.

shot.description: Shot index from 0 inside that scene (with scene; alone: in the scene on screen). A shot id works here too.

shot_id.description: The shot's id from get_project. Or give scene and shot instead. Left out: the shot on screen.

name: get_shot
